name: Judgment Seat
overview: The concept of the Judgment Seat in Scripture reveals a place of authority where decisions and evaluations are made, as seen when Matthew 27:19 describes a judgment seat associated with legal authority. The Apostle Paul’s experiences in Acts 18:12 and Acts 25:10 illustrate earthly judgment seats where legal disputes were addressed. Most importantly, Romans 14:10 points to a future, divine Judgment Seat of Christ, where all believers will stand to give account, emphasizing the ultimate authority of Christ in righteous judgment.
